name: Fondation Louis Vuitton
notes: Frank Gehry's Fondation Louis Vuitton (2014) in the Bois de Boulogne, footprint read off the ground file (about 105 by 45 m, the basin round it) and the rest from published descriptions; no photographs were available. The 'iceberg' of white Ductal volumes stacked to about 32 m, with the auditorium in the middle and terraces between, wrapped in twelve curved glass sails that rise and twist to about 46 m, held on steel struts; the basin it stands in and the grotto's cascade of steps on the east; the Bois' trees round it. The sails are curved slabs made by a generator (each a bowed, twisted sheet), not traced from the real ones; their positions, sizes and pitches are guessed, as are the volumes under them.
